title: A practical takeaway makes a routine easier to repeat because each part answers one simple question.
summary: The same visual grammar can explain a classroom routine, study habit, or parent prompt without adding decorative steps that compete with the instruction.
footer: Keep the cue visible until the learner begins the action.

callout.label: Repeatable rule
callout.value: One signal, one action, one calm confirmation.

definition.meaning: A short routine where a consistent signal starts one small action and a clear confirmation closes the cycle.

keyPoints.label: Signal
keyPoints.detail: Use the same visible or spoken cue each time the routine begins.

keyPoints.label: Move
keyPoints.detail: Describe only the smallest action that proves the learner has started.

keyPoints.label: Confirm
keyPoints.detail: End with a short acknowledgement so the next cue has a clean starting point.
